narrative.overview: This is the faithful visual baseline for the supplied NativoPass mobile homepage: photographic hero slides, a high-saturation category spectrum, an arcade rewards moment, and persistent navigation. Fidelity wins before redesign work begins.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width mobile sections with no hero gutters.
Aqua and purple persistent brand accents.
Press Start 2P isolated to Nativo Rewards.
Desktop phone presentation and full-screen mobile app mode.

rules.name: The Supplied Palette Rule
rules.body: Baseline work uses the documented color endpoints exactly.

rules.name: The Arcade Boundary Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P never appears outside Nativo Rewards.

rules.name: The App-First Rule
rules.body: Device-frame depth never competes with the app artwork.

dos: Do preserve the supplied assets, copy, order, gradients, and typography in the baseline.
Do remove the desktop device frame at 768px and below.
Do preserve this state before redesign variants.
donts: Don't make future variants feel like a generic coupon website, fintech product, or QR scanner.
Don't replace supplied category gradients and line icons with a generic system.
